name: process-event-poll-admission
title: tests(process): pin EventPoll add admission for zero, invalid mask, and duplicates
body:
### What
Pins `EventPoll::add` admission: descriptor 0, zero events, unsupported mask bits, and duplicate active descriptors are rejected; valid single/combined masks accepted; freed slots reusable.

### Why it matters
Admission gates prevent invalid poll registrations that corrupt readiness reporting. Flipping `||` to `&&` admits zero-descriptor entries; XOR instead of AND-NOT misvalidates the event mask. Existing tests exercise only the happy path.

### Mutation evidence (fail-then-pass)
| Mutant | Existing suite | New test |
|---|---|---|
| first `||` -> `&&` | PASS (survives) | FAIL (killed) |
| `& !(...)` -> `^ (...)` | PASS (survives) | FAIL (killed) |

Baseline: PASS. Reproduce: `cargo test -p ginux-process --lib event_poll_add_rejects`.

Prepared with AI assistance; reviewed by me.

name: kernel-views-parse-controllers
title: tests(kernel-views): pin cgroup controller parsing accumulation and whitespace
body:
### What
Pins `parse_controllers`: OR-accumulation of cpu/memory/pids flags, empty-token skipping for trailing/double spaces, unknown-token rejection, and empty-input zero result.

### Why it matters
Controller parsing gates cgroup subtree delegation; replacing `|=` with `&=` drops previously parsed controllers on multi-token input, and deleting the empty-token arm turns benign whitespace into a permission error. No existing test exercises this function.

### Mutation evidence (fail-then-pass)
| Mutant | Existing suite | New test |
|---|---|---|
| `|=` -> `&=` | PASS (survives) | FAIL (killed) |
| delete `b"" => continue` arm | PASS (survives) | FAIL (killed) |

Baseline: PASS. Reproduce: `cargo test -p ginux-kernel-views --lib parse_controllers_accumulates`.

Prepared with AI assistance; reviewed by me.

name: instance-finish-workdir-recipe
title: tests(instance): pin finish workdir preservation and partial-recipe rejection
body:
### What
Pins `finish` bitmask defaults: explicit workdir preserved, absent workdir defaults to /work, contract recipe missing default rejected.

### Why it matters
Bit-shift errors in field masks silently ignore operator-supplied values or admit incomplete recipes. Existing tests never set workdir explicitly nor omit contract default.

### Mutation evidence (fail-then-pass)
| Mutant | Existing suite | New test |
|---|---|---|
| `WORKDIR_BIT 1<<16` -> `1>>16` | PASS (survives) | FAIL (killed) |
| `RECIPE_DEFAULT_BIT 1<<38` -> `1>>38` | PASS (survives) | FAIL (killed) |

Baseline: PASS. Reproduce: `cargo test -p ginux-instance --lib finish_preserves_explicit`.

Prepared with AI assistance; reviewed by me.
spec_ref: TOML config field-presence semantics (instance recipe schema)

name: devices-random-xorshift
title: tests(devices): pin Random read xorshift64 sequence and state advancement
body:
### What
Pins `DeviceRegistry::read` Random xorshift64 sequence: first four bytes match the reference algorithm from default seed, and successive reads advance state.

### Why it matters
The PRNG drives /dev/random output; replacing XOR with OR or flipping shift direction produces a degenerate or predictable stream. Existing tests verify read succeeds but never pin output values.

### Mutation evidence (fail-then-pass)
| Mutant | Existing suite | New test |
|---|---|---|
| `^= ... << 13` -> `\|= ... << 13` | PASS (survives) | FAIL (killed) |
| `<< 13` -> `>> 13` | PASS (survives) | FAIL (killed) |

Baseline: PASS. Reproduce: `cargo test -p ginux-devices --lib random_read_pins`.

Prepared with AI assistance; reviewed by me.

name: vfs-copy-overlay-size-boundary
title: tests(vfs): pin copy_to_overlay exact FILE_SIZE acceptance
body:
### What
Pins `copy_to_overlay` size gate: exact FILE_SIZE fit copies and reads back successfully.

### Why it matters
Relaxing `>` to `>=` rejects valid exact-fit images; relaxing to `==` admits oversized data that slices out of bounds. Existing tests never exercise the exact-boundary overlay copy path.

### Mutation evidence (fail-then-pass)
| Mutant | Existing suite | New test |
|---|---|---|
| `size > FILE_SIZE` -> `size >= FILE_SIZE` | PASS (survives) | FAIL (killed) |
| `size > FILE_SIZE` -> `size == FILE_SIZE` | PASS (survives) | FAIL (killed) |

Baseline: PASS. Reproduce: `cargo test -p ginux-vfs --lib copy_to_overlay_accepts`.

Prepared with AI assistance; reviewed by me.
spec_ref: overlay copy-on-write size invariant (VFS internal contract)

name: fs-policy-identity-token-fnv1a
title: tests(fs-policy): pin identity_token to exact FNV-1a reference hashes
body:
### What
Pins `identity_token` to exact FNV-1a reference hashes for empty, rocky, and peer inputs.

### Why it matters
Instance identity tokens gate capability separation; changing the XOR accumulation to AND/OR produces different hashes that still pass stability/separation checks but break cross-component identity agreement. Existing tests verify properties, not exact values.

### Mutation evidence (fail-then-pass)
| Mutant | Existing suite | New test |
|---|---|---|
| `^=` -> `&=` | PASS (survives) | FAIL (killed) |
| `^=` -> `|=` | PASS (survives) | FAIL (killed) |

Baseline: PASS. Reproduce: `cargo test -p ginux-fs-policy --lib identity_token_matches_fnv1a`.

Prepared with AI assistance; reviewed by me.
